# FDG6014

> DO NOT provide abstractions unless they are tested by developing several concrete implementations and APIs consuming the abstractions.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 6.1.5 Abstractions (Abstract Types and Interfaces).

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not an analyzer candidate: the implementations and consuming APIs that test an abstraction can ship in other assemblies or in tests, which one compilation cannot see. Not library only, like FDG4015, FDG4023 and FDG4024 (sections 4.4 and 4.6).
